description: This file defines types, functions, and logic for handling configuration options, batch processing, and parsing JSON5 data in a CLI context.

methods.name: hasBatchMode
methods.description: Checks if batch mode is enabled based on provided options.

methods.name: hasRefBuilderOptions
methods.description: Determines if reference builder options are set.

methods.name: hasProviderBuilderOptions
methods.description: Checks if provider builder options are set.

methods.name: parseBatchSource
methods.description: Parses batch entries from inline JSON or a file, returning an array of batch entries.
